svg.text: (a) RestoreNet — one compact network for SR, denoising, deblurring and JPEG removal
solid = deployed inference path · dashed = training only · blue = degradation (FDI) conditioning · orange = per-task LoRA adapter points
T = frozen DINOv2-S teacher (train-time only, 0 deploy cost)
L_task in training; at inference picks
routes ↓ which adapter set is active
full-resolution skip (carries fine detail the 4× latent cannot)
global residual: output = LQ + predicted correction
W-MSA: 8×8 windows, 4 heads; odd blocks shift by 4 px. Residual adds around each gated branch.
Attention matmul inputs (q, k, v, softmax) carry INT8 quantizers after QAT.
y = x + γ(f) · IN(x) + β(f), [γ, β] = FC(ReLU(FC(f)))
LoRA layer: W x + b + (α/r) · B_t A_t x
task 0 trains W; task t adds its own (A_t, B_t), rank 8;
B_t = 0 at init so a new task starts from the old behaviour
(b) Continual training → INT8 quantization → edge deployment
FP32 · AdamW + cosine LR · EMA weights · one checkpoint per stage
Replay buffer — ~500 LQ/HQ patches per finished task (reservoir)
25% of every later batch · source of all-task calibration and QAT data
After every stage: evaluate ALL tasks (oracle + inferred routing)
R[i][j] PSNR matrix → ACC · BWT · FGT | held-out compound set (RQ4) | FDI linear probe (RQ2)
Report: FP32 vs PTQ vs QAT, per task
ΔPSNR / ΔLPIPS · BWT before vs after QAT · params, GFLOPs, latency
